lines.text: Sennacherib king of Assyria invaded Judah, and Hezekiah saw that he had come to make war against Jerusalem.
Hezekiah consulted his leaders, and many people stopped up all the springs and the stream that flowed through the land.
Hezekiah rebuilt the wall, produced many chariots and horses, and told the people the LORD was with them.
Sennacherib besieged Damascus and sent servants to Jerusalem, and he also wrote letters mocking the LORD.
Hezekiah and Isaiah prayed, and the LORD sent an angel who annihilated Assyria's leaders and saved Jerusalem.
